description: Feature details with code evidence, recent changes, contributors and count-only use and feedback. Health is available to VIEWER and above, not GUEST. Usage counts signed-in people from featury's own tracker over a stated 30-day UTC window; ratings exclude help pages and support answers. Visitor words and identities are not returned. healthUnavailable is true when health could not be read; the code detail stays available, and you can retry the same call.

changeLimit.description: How many recent changes to include. Default 10, 0 to omit them, max 50

name: get_feature
title: Get feature details
